name: What are the advantages of thermal imaging in moisture intrusion assessments?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of thermal imaging in moisture intrusion assessments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thermal imaging is a non-invasive technique that detects temperature differences on the roof surface, which can indicate the presence of trapped moisture. Water has a higher thermal mass than dry roofing materials, so it heats up and cools down at a different rate, making it visible through infrared. This method helps identify hidden moisture without damaging the roof, allowing for precise targeting of problem areas and more accurate repair recommendations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Thermal imaging non-invasively detects hidden moisture by showing temperature differences caused by water's unique thermal properties, pinpointing problem areas.
